comment: Bankable wallet of each client group by fiscal year and product family (Account Planning; FY2024-FY2026): the estimated total revenue pool the group pays all banks, SMBC's revenue and share of wallet, the top competitor bank (fictional) and its share, and the untapped gap. FY2026 SMBC revenue is H1 year to date (smbc_revenue_basis = H1 YTD) and is annualised in smbc_revenue_annualised_usd. Share of Wallet % = SUM(smbc_revenue_annualised_usd) / SUM(estimated_wallet_usd); amounts add across groups and families within a fiscal year (never across years). Grain: one row per client group x fiscal year x product family.
